reviews.reason: PKCS #1 reader support verifies raw signature against the /Cert key; that is separate from user trust. The format is deprecated but reader support remains useful and does not imply a writer commitment.

reviews.decision: Reaffirm basic material/Unknown policy; reopen narrow PAdES timing conditions
reviews.reason: Document-carried CRL/OCSP are used and Unknown is not Good. §12.8.3.4.7 says current UTC must be within the CRL thisUpdate/nextUpdate interval and OCSP must be captured before signer notAfter; historical .8 independently requires collection before signer notAfter and permits a later-issued CRL when nextUpdate remains after the past instant. Keep those contexts distinct. The source's two-ended CRL interval conflicts with the implementation comment's one-ended ETSI freshness interpretation, so record that conflict explicitly. Known Revoked status on a TSA path must also affect whether its genTime can be used under the reason carveout.

The four-step timestamp establishment decision accounts for an anchored authority path but not §12.8.3.4.8's separate current revocation/reason rules. A path that reached an anchor may carry Revocation::Revoked; `viewer-core/src/notes.rs::signature_timestamps_instant` currently extracts `at` from every Time::Established, and `established_over` does the same for document timestamp links, so the downstream BestSignatureTime can use the token despite that known status. Past-time material capture cutoffs and the .4.7 current-time CRL lower bound / OCSP capture cutoff also need separate treatment. Preserve the separate ordering and host-anchor choices.
Trust anchors remain host supplied and no embedded certificate becomes trusted merely by being present. This audit does not propose network revocation fetches.

Keeping signature integrity, signature authenticity, path/trust, timestamp-time evidence, and revocation as distinct answers is sound. The issue is timestamp consumers omitting the included revocation answer when selecting BestSignatureTime; do not infer a mandatory UI note or combine crypto integrity with trust policy.

scope_reference: Held EC3 PDF, clauses 12.8.3.2, 12.8.3.3.2, 12.8.3.4.2, 12.8.3.4.6-.8. No network revocation fetch or UI note requirement assessed.
